title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1973-09-20

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording with decent SBD clarity after a rough audience intro captures a solid 1973 show highlighted by a soaring China > Rider and a powerful Truckin > Eyes sequence.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its tight playing and memorable moments, especially the first‑set China > Rider stretch and the second‑set Truckin > Eyes transition with the horn section adding color. Recording quality is mixed – the early audience mono segment is muddy, but the later soundboard feed is clear and listenable, making the overall tape worth revisiting.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give high marks (4‑5 stars) and highlight strong musical performances; recording issues are noted but limited to the early audience portion, resulting in an overall solid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early AUD mono segment is muddy and low fidelity; SBD portion from mid‑show onward sounds great and clear, making the recording generally listenable despite the rough start.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds with a standout China > Rider jam; second set, though shorter than typical ’73 shows, stays tight and features the horn‑enhanced Truckin > Eyes sequence and a lively Sugar Magnolia finish.
